Ten styles, generated on your Mac

Fifty images, all made locally with Stable Diffusion 1.5 on the M1 — no subscription, no credits, no card. Every style is drawn with five of our real characters so you can judge fit rather than vibe. The small square on each card is the same image at 28 px, the size it appears at in a list.

Stars are my read on fit for this specific app, not on how pretty the picture is.

The ten

Эмалевый значок

★★★★☆

Cloisonné pin: gold rim, glossy enamel fill.

Works: Reads as a collectible object, which is literally what we sell. Consistent gold frame across every character — instant family resemblance.

Breaks: Faces go muddy at this resolution, and the cosmonaut collapsed into a blank oval mask. Needs a face-clarity pass.

Гуашь, детская книга

★★★★★

Soviet children's-book painting, flat shapes, thick outlines.

Works: The only style where all five characters read correctly — including the cosmonaut, which every other attempt has failed. Warm, human, on-brand for self-deprecating humour.

Breaks: Less 'collectible object', more 'illustration'. Rarity would have to come from the frame, not the art.

Палех

★★★☆☆

Lacquer miniature, gold leaf on black.

Works: Genuinely luxurious. Perfect for the top tiers — 1350 and 1650 could live here.

Breaks: SD keeps adding picture frames, which waste half the canvas. Too rich for a 50-coin avatar.

Матрёшка (сгенерированная)

★☆☆☆☆

Painted nesting doll.

Works: The concept still holds — my hand-drawn version works.

Breaks: Generation fails it: the model produces photos of generic dolls and ignores the character entirely. Gopnik and cosmonaut are indistinguishable. Hand-drawn only.

Агитплакат

★★☆☆☆

Constructivist poster, red / black / cream.

Works: The most striking row on the page. Unmistakably Russian, brutal contrast, superb at small size.

Breaks: Faces become abstract masks — you cannot tell the characters apart. Would work as a frame or background treatment, not as the portrait.

Лубок

★★☆☆☆

Folk woodcut print, hand-coloured.

Works: All five read, and it is authentically Russian folk rather than Soviet.

Breaks: Muted and papery. Looks like a museum exhibit, not something a 22-year-old shows off in a chat.

Метро-мозаика

★★★★☆

Smalt mosaic, Moscow metro monumental style.

Works: Beautiful, and the round medallion shape is already an avatar. The most specifically Moscow style here — this is what the stations actually look like.

Breaks: Tesserae detail gets lost small; the face needs simplifying so it survives 28px.

Почтовая марка

★★★☆☆

Engraved Soviet stamp, fine line etching.

Works: Characters read clearly, the perforated edge is a natural frame, and it fits the 'collect the set' framing perfectly.

Breaks: Nearly monochrome, so the rarity ladder has almost nothing to escalate with.

Бумажная аппликация

★★☆☆☆

Layered cut paper with soft shadows.

Works: Clean and modern; the cosmonaut and shaurmaster came out well.

Breaks: Inconsistent — half the row drifted grey and lost the paper look entirely.

Гжель

★☆☆☆☆

Cobalt blue on white porcelain.

Works: Strong single idea, very Russian.

Breaks: One colour means every character looks the same, and SD turned them all into framed plates. Weakest row.

What the grid actually shows

Гуашь for the characters, мозаика or эмаль for the frame

Gouache is the only style where all five characters read — and critically, it is the first time in this whole project that the cosmonaut has come out right, with a real helmet and a visible face. Every hand-drawn attempt and every other generated style failed that one.

Metro mosaic is the most Moscow thing here and it arrives already shaped like an avatar — a round medallion. If you want the app to look like nothing else, this is it.

Agitprop is the best-looking row and the least usable. The faces become masks; you cannot tell гопник from шаурмастер. It would make an excellent frame, background, or share-tile treatment — just not the portrait.

Three are dead: generated matryoshka (the model draws generic dolls and ignores the character), gzhel (one colour, no ladder, and it keeps making plates), and papercut (drifts grey and loses the effect half the time).
